brand.name: Roktolagbe
home.hero.question: Need blood?
home.hero.answer: Pick the group. We will show you donors nearby.
home.grid.label: Choose a blood group
home.stats.label: By the numbers
home.cta.register.title: Someone may need your blood
home.cta.register.body: Signing up takes two minutes. Your phone number is never shown publicly.
home.how.title: How it works
home.how.1.title: Pick a group
home.how.1.body: Or tap once to use your location.
home.how.2.title: Nearby donors hear about it
home.how.2.body: We email donors close to you. First 5km, then wider if we need to.
home.how.3.title: When someone says yes
home.how.3.body: You get their phone number then. Not before.

page.eligibility.title: Can I donate blood?
page.wall.title: Donors
page.learn.title: About donating blood

common.comingSoon: This part is still being built.
offline.title: No internet
offline.body: You are offline. Showing you what you saw last.
config.missing.title: This site is not connected to a database yet
config.missing.body: Whoever runs this site needs to add the Supabase URL and key. Sample data is shown until then.
notfound.title: Page not found
notfound.body: There is nothing at this address. The link may be old.
footer.about: Roktolagbe is a free, open source project. Nobody pays and nobody gets paid.
footer.emergency: In an emergency, contact a hospital blood bank directly. This site is not a medical service.
form.displayName.hint: Leave this blank and we will show only your first name.
form.contact.promise: Your phone number is never shown on this site. It goes to one person, once, and only if you say yes to their request.
form.whatsapp.hint: Only if it is different from your mobile number.
form.email.hint: This is where we tell you someone nearby needs blood.
form.email.hint.optional: Leave blank if you do not want to be told about requests.
form.facebook.hint: Helps the person asking know who you are.
form.address.hint: Shown to one person after you say yes. Never shown publicly.
form.dob.hint: You need to be between {min} and {max} to donate.
form.lastDonation.hint: Leave blank if you never have.
form.lastDonation.wait: You can give blood again from {date}. Register now and we will tell you when it is time.
form.consent.email: Email me when someone nearby needs blood
form.consent.email.hint: Every email has a one-tap link to stop them.
form.consent.listing: Show me in the donor list
form.consent.listing.hint: First name, blood group and district only. Never your number. Say no and you can still be emailed when someone needs you.
form.consent.eligible: I am healthy and this information is correct
form.consent.eligible.hint: The hospital will check you again before you donate.
validation.phoneInvalid: That number does not look right. Use 11 digits, like 01712345678.
validation.emailInvalid: That email address does not look right.
validation.emailNeededForAlerts: We need an email address to tell you about requests.
validation.tooYoung: You need to be at least 18 to give blood.
validation.tooOld: Blood is usually not taken after 65.
validation.tooLight: You need to weigh at least 45 kg to give blood.
validation.dateInFuture: That date cannot be after today.
validation.mustConfirm: Please tick the box to continue.
register.intro: This takes two minutes. Your phone number is never shown publicly.
register.error.notConfigured: This site is not connected to a database yet, so registration is off.
register.error.rateLimited: Please try again shortly. There have been several attempts from this connection.
register.error.offline: No internet. Press again when you are back online.
register.error.unknown: That did not send. Please try again in a moment.
location.locateMe.title: Use my location instead
location.locateMe.body: Your browser will ask your permission. If you would rather not, use the lists below.
location.accuracy.poor: This could be off by about {metres} metres. Drag the pin to correct it.
location.error.denied: You did not allow location access.
location.error.timeout: Finding your location is taking too long.
location.error.unavailable: Your location is not available right now.
location.error.unsupported: Your browser cannot provide a location.
location.error.fallback: Pick your district and upazila below instead.
location.error.outsideCountry: That location looks like it is outside Bangladesh. Please pick from the lists below.
location.places.failed: Could not load the district list. Check your connection and try again.
location.map.label: Location map
location.map.help: Drag the pin, or tap anywhere on the map.
location.pin.title: Your location
location.privacy: The public map never shows where you really are. It moves your point by up to 800 metres.
success.title: Done. Thank you.
success.body: You are on the list. If someone near you needs blood, we will let you know.
success.share.text: I just registered as a {group} blood donor on Roktolagbe. You can too.
success.next.title: What happens next
success.next.1: You get an email when someone nearby needs your blood group.
success.next.2: If you say yes, that one person gets your number. Nobody else.
success.next.3: You can stop the emails with one tap, from any of them.
